notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Budget schedules (p12-16) are budgetary basis, so they differ slightly from the GAAP fund statement. Nonmajor combining statement has 18 fund columns, so detail uses its Total column (p20). Internal service funds (p21-22, health insurance and IT) are excluded from business-type; their transfer in 1,359,567 is the governmental net transfers out. Business-type: enterprise funds total column (p7); the printed fund-level restatement (Electric +3,768,723 / Combined System Utilities -3,768,723) nets to zero in the Total column, so beginning net position is 254,966,043 with no restatement. Contributions in aid of construction and loss on disposal recorded as business_type other_financing. Ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents; certificates of deposit as ending_investments; county treasurer cash 471,679 is a separate line. No deferred outflows/inflows printed on the Statement of Net Position. Read pages 1-22 of 22
